title: [R3] Unhandled errors in Message/set result.type leave optimistic messages in pending state
description:
In sendMessage (line 474), error handling only checks for result.notCreated. But if Message/set fails with result.type error (e.g., 'serverFailure'), the code proceeds without throwing.

Then at line 481: const created = result.created && result.created.c0
Since result.created is undefined in error responses, created = falsy.
The optimistic bubble is never removed or marked as failed.

Symptom: User sees message stuck in 'pending' state after a server error, but no error dialog shown.

Fix: Check for result.type error first, before checking notCreated:
  if (result.type) throw new Error('Message/set error: ' + result.type);
